name: Good Luck, Minutes Man!
source:
Welcome to New L'manburg! 

Your name is Ranboo. You're the nation's official minutes man, and you have a very long day ahead of you. 

[From [url=https://thistlemints.itch.io/good-luck-minutes-man]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到New L'manburg！

你叫Ranboo，是国家的官方会议记录员，今天的日程将会很长。

[来源：[url=https://thistlemints.itch.io/good-luck-minutes-man]Itch.io[/url]]
